Hi team —

Quick reminder: we need to finalize scores for Kai and lock the scorecard by EOD PST today so we can push to the hiring committee tomorrow morning. Current ask:
- If you haven't, please upload your completed scorecard to the Drive link below and add any 1–2 line clarifying rationale for any score that differs by >1 point from the median.
- If you want a short tie-break call for any dimension (esp. System Design), note it in the sheet and ping availability.

Attachments: scorecard-template.xlsx, kai_nakamura_resume.pdf
Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/Kai_Nakamura/scorecards
HubSpot: HUBSPOT-PR-7482

Why today: the hiring committee has a tight window tomorrow and we want to avoid last-minute surprises — if we have converged scores + short rationale, the committee can make a confident call.

If you think we should weight the System Design dimension higher (given the role focus), call it out here; otherwise we'll proceed with the standard weighting.

Thanks —
Grace

Subject: Re: Final score harvest and lock: Kai Nakamura (SWE Staff)

Grace — uploaded my card (marissa_annotated-scorecard.xlsx).
TL;DR: I gave Kai a 4 on System Design, 5 on Coding, 4 on Ownership, 4 on Communication. My main variance vs others is the System Design call: I penalized the lack of latency/scale tradeoffs in his example and the follow-up probing didn't surface operational constraints.

Notes inline in the sheet; short rationale pasted here: "Good instincts and clear structure, but the example lacked explicit scaling constraints and there was limited evidence of tuning for cost/latency trade-offs. Would hire for IC3->IC4 but concerned for Staff scoped ownership on infra-heavy products today."

If others agree this should be weighted up/down, say so; otherwise I'm ok with a tie-break for that dimension.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 13:48:46 -0700
Subject: Re: Final score harvest and lock: Kai Nakamura (SWE Staff)

Marissa — I see your point. My scoring: SD 5, Coding 4, Ownership 5, Communication 4.

Quick context: I probed a follow-up about cache invalidation and he gave a reasonable approach but didn't discuss KV cache sizing or hotkey mitigation; I still thought his architecture was solid for a mid-stage product. I landed on a 5 because his end-to-end tradeoffs were acceptable and he advocated for iterative measurement.

Given the split (Marissa 4 vs me 5 on SD), I agree a short 15m tie-break with any one of you (Grace/Tessa/Dylan) could resolve the final weight for System Design. Otherwise we can keep standard weights and push the tally.

—Logan

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Final score harvest and lock: Kai Nakamura (SWE Staff)

Thanks — I uploaded voting-sheet.csv and left a one-line rationale per dimension. My scores: SD 4, Coding 5, Ownership 4, Communication 5.

Proposal to converge quickly:
- Keep standard weights (SD 30%, Coding 30%, Ownership 20%, Comm 20%) unless 3+ people ask to reweight. No reweight requested by more than one person, so keep it.
- Grace: if you want, run the weighted tally and publish the final numbers. If the SD dimension ends up 4.33 vs 4.67 (example), we can do a 15m panel tie-break tomorrow morning before the hiring committee rather than delaying today.

Availability: I can do a 15m slot 8:30–9:00am PST tomorrow if needed.

—Tessa

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@talentco.com>, Emily Chen <emily@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:05:22 -0700
Subject: RE: Final score harvest and lock: Kai Nakamura (SWE Staff)

Thanks everyone — consolidated the inputs and locked the scorecard. Final weighted averages: SD 4.33, Coding 4.75, Ownership 4.25, Communication 4.25; overall composite 4.45.

Decision path: per the group preference we kept standard weights. The overall composite lands just below our bar for a direct Staff hire this cycle; recommendation to the hiring committee: extend a Senior+ (IC4) offer with an engineering leadership growth plan and a re-eval milestone at 9 months.

Next steps (action items):
- Grace: I will prepare the 1-page candidate brief and chair the hiring committee meeting (scheduled 11:30am PST). Drive brief & scorecards linked here: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/Kai_Nakamura/scorecards
- Marissa: please add 2–3 bullet talking points (concerns + coaching suggestions) to the doc by 10:30am.
- Logan/Tessa/Dylan: if you disagree with the recommendation, reply-all with a dissent by 10:30am so we can escalate to the committee.
- Sara (recruiter): hold off on offer drafting until committee confirms; candidate should not be contacted with an offer until we have committee sign-off.

Thanks for quick responses — the format worked well. I left the attachments for record (final scorecard bundle).

Grace O'Connor
Recruiting Lead, Engineering
Redwood Inference
